      Our Story

      Deep Instinct is Reinventing Cybersecurity

      Deep Instinct was founded in 2015 with a bold idea: that deep learning could fundamentally change cybersecurity. Our founders set out to build a new kind of prevention—technology capable of stopping threats before they execute. Today, our Data Security X (DSX) platform helps organizations around the world stay ahead of increasingly sophisticated attacks. With operations in New York and Tel Aviv, our team of researchers, engineers, and security experts is redefining what prevention can look like.

      Watch video

      Find Your Future

      Prevention Starts with Deep Instinct

      Deep Instinct has developed the world’s first and only purpose-built deep learning cybersecurity framework powered by the DSX Brain, a deep neural network  that mimics the logic of the human brain. We prevent zero-day attacks across cloud, NAS, applications, and endpoints, while offering unrivaled explainability into unknown threats.

      Join some of the smartest minds in cybersecurity, developing and deploying the world's most advanced zero-day data security solution.
